nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Custom modifier positioning the Back link next to breadcrumbs; the link points at href="#" and is wired up by client-side JS rather than being a real server-rendered previous-page href.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Non-govuk modifier class plus a JS-driven back link. The new app should use a standard GOV.UK Back link with a real server-side href to the previous page, not a JS hash link.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Back link component with a genuine href to the previous step.

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: Hidden field carrying the system-computed highest risk category across the commodities on the consignment. Observed value 'High' in BOTH the High-risk and the Medium-risk trace, so it reflects the commodities' computed maximum, independent of which radio the user picks.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Not a govuk component but a load-bearing requirement: IPAFFS pre-computes a highest-risk-category server-side and posts it back. The rebuild must decide whether the risk category is user-selected, system-derived, or a user override of a system default — the page title says 'Select the highest' yet the system already knows the computed highest.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: n/a (data-carrying hidden input, not a visual component)
nonStandardPatterns.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 29 (controls29); trace ba5323fd63dcda25ee5e37c013c511d2949410bc action 27 (hidden still 'High' while user selects Medium)

nonStandardPatterns.whatItDoes: The fieldset legend is rendered empty; the visible question is carried entirely by the H1 above the form.
nonStandardPatterns.concern: Radios sit in a fieldset with no legend text. GOV.UK pattern for a single question per page is legend-as-page-heading (legend contains the H1). Empty legend is a minor accessibility deviation — the fieldset has no accessible name.
nonStandardPatterns.govukAlternative: Radios with the question as the fieldset legend styled as the page heading (govuk-fieldset__legend--xl wrapping an h1).

fields.name: risk-category
fields.label: Select the highest risk category for the commodities in this consignment
fields.requiredEvidence: The legacy frontend validator makes risk-category a required string and restricts it to the risk choices offered for the journey (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:14-31; the cloning variant is likewise required at :34-43). The POST handler always applies that validator and re-renders the page with mapped errors on failure (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:74-91). This is legacy journey mandatoriness rather than an @NotNull rule on the shared notification model, so the rebuild may revisit the policy while retaining an equivalent decision.
fields.conditionalOn: The standard page offers Medium and Low, adding High only when the risk service returns UNKNOWN or ERROR (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:180-197). In the health-certificate cloning variant it instead offers only High and Medium (:180-186), and omits highest-risk-category (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/selectRiskCategory.html:38-40).
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 29 (High selected); trace ba5323fd63dcda25ee5e37c013c511d2949410bc action 27 (Medium selected); page-objects/notification/SelectRiskCategoryPage.ts:6 (generic radio locator by accessible name); page-objects/notification/SelectRiskCategoryPage.ts:10 (Low risk locator); page-objects/notification/SelectRiskCategoryPage.ts:14 (Save and continue); types/risk-category.ts:1 (complete High risk, Medium risk and Low risk vocabulary); workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:37 (risk category is configurable); workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:129 (Medium risk default); workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:315 (workflow checks the configured category); tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-manipulation.spec.ts:51 (explicit Low risk amendment); tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-manipulation.spec.ts:68 (review asserts Low risk); tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-notification.spec.ts:48 (review asserts High risk)

fields.name: highest-risk-category
fields.label: (hidden) system-computed highest risk category for the consignment's commodities
fields.requiredEvidence: The standard legacy validator accepts highest-risk-category as a High/Medium/Low string but does not call .required(), so it is not independently mandatory (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:21-30). The template omits it entirely for the cloning-health-certificate branch (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/views/importer/selectRiskCategory.html:38-40).
fields.evidence: trace 94d29a163f6ab37556cd585b4eabeec9b9c27d84 action 29 (controls29, value=High); trace ba5323fd63dcda25ee5e37c013c511d2949410bc action 27 (still value=High while Medium radio selected)

validationMessages.message: Select if the highest risk category is high risk, medium risk or low risk
validationMessages.trigger: Submitting without a selection, or with a value outside High/Medium/Low, when highest-risk-category is High.
validationMessages.evidence: Verbatim legacy copy is RISK_CATEGORY_HIGH_MEDIUM_LOW_MESSAGE at ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/messages/en.js:138. The standard validator selects it when highest-risk-category is High and maps both Joi's required and invalid-value failures to it (service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:14-25).

validationMessages.message: Select if the highest risk category is medium risk or low risk
validationMessages.trigger: Submitting without a selection, or with a value outside Medium/Low, when highest-risk-category is Medium.
validationMessages.evidence: Verbatim legacy copy is RISK_CATEGORY_MEDIUM_LOW_MESSAGE at ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/messages/en.js:140. The standard validator selects it when highest-risk-category is not High, limits valid values to Medium/Low, and maps both required and invalid-value failures to it (service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:14-25).

validationMessages.message: Select if the highest risk category is high risk or medium risk
validationMessages.trigger: Submitting the health-certificate cloning variant without a selection, or with a value outside High/Medium.
validationMessages.evidence: Verbatim legacy copy is RISK_CATEGORY_HIGH_MEDIUM_MESSAGE at ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/messages/en.js:139. The cloning validator permits High/Medium, requires the field, and maps both required and invalid-value failures to this message (service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:34-43).

openQuestions: The QA workflow treats risk category as user-selected and persists it to review (workflows/notification/ched-p-workflows.ts:315; tests/notification/ched-p/ched-p-manipulation.spec.ts:68), but the hidden 'highest-risk-category' trace field remains 'High' even when the user selects Medium. Clarify whether that hidden computed maximum constrains or validates the user's selection.
The empty fieldset legend means the radio group has no accessible name — confirm whether the new app should adopt the standard legend-as-heading pattern.

RESOLVED FROM LEGACY: no error-state trace captured the missing/invalid-selection copy, but the authorised legacy validators supply three branch-specific messages: High/Medium/Low, Medium/Low, and the cloning-only High/Medium copy (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/messages/en.js:138-140; wired at service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:14-43).
Values posted are 'High'/'Medium'/'Low' (not 'High risk' etc.) — confirm the canonical enum the new backend should store.

Legacy policy point: risk-category is mandatory in the frontend Joi validator (ipaffs-frontend-notification/service/src/validation/routes/handlers/importer/select_risk_category.js:14-31), while the choice set is shaped by risk-service output (:180-209). The rebuild should decide whether users may override the computed category and which options should be offered; this enrichment records the old-system rule without treating it as immutable policy.
